title: 第13章 狠下心第14章 宗门招新
slug: 为了长生不死我带着全宗修仙
content_zh:
;;
山匪都快被电成羊癫疯了，本来以为会被电死，结果就看到对方停了下来。
几个山匪赶紧跪地求饶，“前辈！实在是对不住，我们几个只是想混口饭吃，并没有别的意思。前辈，您就当咱们几个是个屁行不行？饶了我们吧。”
寂月没理会他们几个人的话，而是转头看向后面的叶无忧，一把将剑丢了过去。
“试试。”
叶无忧受宠若惊地接过剑，看着那几个山匪，有些迟疑。
犹豫了一会儿，还是提着剑冲了过去。
区区几个炼气期的山匪而已，让师父出手简直是大材小用，甚至有点侮辱到师父了。
山匪见一个仅仅炼气期一层的小姑娘都敢对自己动手，想嘲笑但是又不敢，没看见那个前辈还盯着他们看吗？
叶无忧的一招一式并不连贯，躲避山匪的招式甚至还有点慌乱，毕竟这是她第一次对战。
以前在家也没学习过什么武功，现如今能躲过那些杀招，也属实不容易。
寂月在一旁观摩，不仅是看叶无忧学习的怎么样，也是想从中学习到点什么，毕竟她一直都是被系统灌顶，根本就没有系统的学习过。
说是系统推演的功法，到最后她还是得将其领悟一番，才能交给弟子。
悟性是个很玄妙的东西，有些人终其一生也只能卡在练气大圆满，而极少数人能够顺利的飞升。
寂月不知道自己属于哪一种，但为了长生不死的目标，她就算倾尽所有，也要达成。
“此剑法主杀，你的招式太过柔弱，发挥不出它的真正实力。若是你连伤人都做不到，日后还想谈及报仇？流光已经很配合你了，你再这样下去，流光会失望的。”
剑修的剑可不会轻易给出去，已经认主的剑，只会听命于主人。
要不是寂月亲手把剑丢给叶无忧，流光早就反噬她了。
只是这招式太过软绵，发挥不出这套功法十分之一的实力，也导致流光的心情逐渐暴躁起来。
它可不是什么娇滴滴的小木剑，它可是主杀的凶剑！

叶无忧此前的生活虽然凄惨，但是从未伤过谁，一直都是被欺负的对象。
现在让她主动伤人，一时半会还做不到。
但是师父说的话也没错，如果她再抱着这种态度修炼下去，日后的仇不仅报不了，估计之后的修炼也很难精进下去。
咬了咬牙，她的眼神逐渐坚定起来，手中握着流光，挥砍间带着凌厉的气势。
眼前的三个山匪已经不是普通的敌人了，而是她的仇人，是仇人就应该杀了！
叶无忧本就是雷系灵根，这套剑法也格外的贴合她，周遭的雷系灵气因她的招式被吸引过来。
天空中云层翻涌，她的身边也附带着一层电流，体内的灵力也在疯狂游走。
又来了。
山匪兄弟悔的肠子都青了，这什么世道啊，打个劫还能被雷劈，不知道的还以为他们是在渡劫呢。
到底只是几个无门无派的散修，而且平时也疏于修炼，到最后尽数落败于刚刚练气的叶无忧手中。
叶无忧犹豫了一会，最后还是狠下心，把这几个山匪给杀了。
斩草不除根，春风吹又生。

The bandit was almost going crazy from the electric shock. He originally thought he would be electrocuted to death, but saw the other party stop.
Several bandits quickly knelt down and begged for mercy, "Senior! I'm really sorry. We just want to make a living and have no other intentions. Senior, can you just treat us as nothings? Please spare us."
Jiyue ignored what they said, but turned to look at Ye Wuyou behind her, and threw the sword away.
"Try it."
Ye Wuyou took the sword flattered and looked at the bandits with some hesitation.
After hesitating for a while, he still rushed over with his sword in hand.
They were just a few bandits in the Qi refining stage. It was overkill for the master to take action, and it was even a bit insulting to the master.
When the bandits saw that a little girl who was only at the first level of Qi Refining Stage dared to attack him, they wanted to laugh at him but they didn't dare. Didn't they see that the senior was still staring at them?
Ye Wuyou's moves were inconsistent, and her moves to avoid the bandits were even a little panicked. After all, this was her first battle.
I didn't learn any martial arts at home before, but now it's not easy to avoid those killing moves.
Jiyue watched from the sidelines, not only to see how Ye Wuyou was studying, but also to learn something from it. After all, she had always been initiated by the system and had never studied systematically at all.
It was said that the technique was systematically deduced, but in the end she still had to understand it before giving it to her disciples.
Comprehension is a very mysterious thing. Some people can only be stuck in the Great Perfection of Qi training throughout their lives, while very few people can successfully ascend.
Jiyue didn't know which category she belonged to, but for the goal of immortality, she would spend everything she had to achieve it.
"This sword technique is the main killer. Your move is too weak and cannot bring out its true strength. If you can't even hurt someone, do you still want to talk about revenge in the future? Liu Guang has been very cooperative with you. If you continue like this, Liu Guang will be disappointed."
The sword of a swordsman will not be given away easily. The sword that has recognized its owner will only obey the owner's orders.
If Jiyue hadn't thrown the sword to Ye Wuyou herself, Liuguang would have turned back on her.
It's just that this move is too weak and cannot bring out one-tenth of the strength of this set of techniques, which also makes Liu Guang's mood gradually become irritable.
It's not a cute little wooden sword, it's a murderous sword!
Although Ye Wuyou's previous life was miserable, he had never hurt anyone and was always the target of bullying.
Now let her take the initiative to hurt people, and she won't be able to do it for a while.
But what the master said is correct. If she continues to practice with this attitude, not only will she not be able to avenge herself in the future, but it is also estimated that it will be difficult to improve in her subsequent practice.
Gritting her teeth, her eyes gradually became firmer, holding the streamer in her hand, and she slashed with fierce momentum.
The three bandits in front of her are no longer ordinary enemies, but her enemies. If they are enemies, they should be killed!
Ye Wuyou has a lightning spiritual root, and this set of swordsmanship suits her particularly well. The surrounding thunder spiritual energy is attracted by her moves.
The clouds were surging in the sky, and there was also a layer of electricity around her, and the spiritual power in her body was also swimming wildly.
here we go again.
The bandit brothers were so sorry that their intestines turned green. What kind of world is this? They could be struck by lightning even if they were trying to survive a robbery. Those who didn't know better thought they were just trying to overcome a robbery.
After all, they were just a few casual cultivators without any sect, and they usually neglected to practice. In the end, they all lost to Ye Wuyou, who had just practiced Qi.
Ye Wuyou hesitated for a while, but finally decided to kill these bandits.
Cut the grass without eradicating its roots, but it will grow again when the spring breeze blows.
